title: Synchronization bridge for API/Console/Runtime launches
creator: Priya Patel
description: Establish a lightweight 'synchronization bridge' pattern to coordinate milestones, finalize release notes, and manage cross-team handoffs for the April 2026 release covering Redwood API, Console, and Runtime components. Deliverables: synchronized milestone calendar, cutline decision runbook, templated release notes drafts, SLAs for rollback/fallback and a triage escalation flow.
acceptance_criteria: Master calendar published and accepted by Eng/Design/Support/Docs
Cut criteria documented and approved by Release Council
Release notes draft for API/Console/Runtime in Drive with owners and review comments
Cross-team readiness signoffs captured in the milestone tracker
Rollback playbook documented with owner and test checklist
updates: 2026-03-01 – Created ticket; scoped with Eng leads (Liam O'Connor) and Design (Marisol Vega)
2026-03-04 – Decision: adopt 'rolling cut' where non-blocking cosmetic work is slotted to post-release patch; documented rationale in Confluence (link)
2026-03-07 – PM review: consolidated release notes template v0.1 shared in Drive (https://drive.google.com/example)
2026-03-10 – Eng provided perf signal thresholds for runtime cut criteria (ENG-4123); added as dependency
2026-03-12 – Risk: dedicated capacity autoscaler E2E tests delayed; mitigation: extend canary window and disable non-critical dashboards for initial rollout
2026-03-14 – Assigned Jordan Kim as launch owner; scheduled cross-functional readiness sync 2026-03-20 10:00 PT
notes: Trade-off: locking scope earlier reduces regression risk but increases missed opportunity for last-minute performance fixes
Decision log updated with cutline rationale; prefer 'safety-first' for API surface changes and 'cost-first' for runtime optimizations
